definitions.explanation: A feeling of deep respect mixed with wonder or fear, typically directed toward something sacred, powerful, or beyond human understanding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{敬畏|けいい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧。
examples.english: A sense of awe toward nature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{村人|むらびと}→村人：13062_murabito⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{敬畏|けいい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}ていた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: The villagers looked upon the mountain with reverence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神秘|しんぴ}→神秘：13734_shinpi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{敬畏|けいい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}か→抱く：02010_idaku⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はいられない。
examples.english: One cannot help but feel a sense of awe at the mystery of life.

notes:
A compound of {敬|けい} (respect) and {畏|い} (awe/fear). Combines reverence with a sense of being overwhelmed by something greater than oneself. More literary and elevated than simple respect.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敬畏|けいい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧: a feeling of awe/reverence
- {敬畏|けいい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧: to hold a sense of awe
- {敬畏|けいい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧: object of reverence
- {敬畏|けいい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to revere

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{敬意|けいい}→敬意：02781_keii⟧: respect — a homophone but without the element of awe or fear; more straightforward respect
- ⟦{畏敬|いけい}→畏敬：10033_ikei⟧: awe and respect — same kanji in reverse order with identical meaning; ⟦{畏敬|いけい}→畏敬：10033_ikei⟧ is slightly more common
- ⟦{崇拝|すうはい}→崇拝：10032_suuhai⟧: worship, adoration — stronger, implies devoted worship of a person or deity
